PCSing? Skip the on-base housing! This nice, well maintained 1997-built home offers 1,361 sq ft of functional, easy living. Features include a cozy fireplace, high ceilings in the living room, and a well-appointed kitchen. The thoughtful design includes a side-entrance garage, enhancing the home's lovely exterior and providing additional parking. Situated on a prime corner lot, the home provides extra yard space, privacy, and fantastic curb appeal in a mature, established neighborhood that is highly accessible to local military facilities. Located minutes from the Fort Hood Warrior Way gate, this is the perfect, stress-free spot for military families looking for proximity to work without sacrificing space. Schedule your showing today!
